newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank takes all bids in 4-day repo at limit.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank takes all bids in 4-day repo at limit.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Thursday it accepted all bids in its four-day repo tender at maximum limit of 75 percent.
The central bank did not reveal any details on amounts drained from the market through the tender.
The CNB also took all bids in its two one-week repo tenders at the 75 percent limit earlier on Thursday.

The central bank also cut access to Lombard credit and limited non-resident access to the money market on Thursday stabilise the money market and help the crown which has been under strong pressure since last week.
